newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ to seek new ways to improve SOE efficiencies.
newsitem.headline: NZ to seek new ways to improve SOE efficiencies.

text.p: New Zealand Treasurer Winston Peters on Thursday outlined plans to seek new efficiencies from state-owned enterprises and pave the way for a new phase of asset disposals.
He said the proceeds from any asset sales "will be used to repay public debt".

"The government must ensure that its own businesses are not artificially supprted by unrealistially low debt levels. We will be asking them to adjust their capital structures to achieve a debt to equity ratio in line with that of comparable private sector busines," Peters said.
The government would consider "whether to keep" state-owned enterprises (soes) that have not been specifically identified as strategic assets, on a case-by-case basis.

"As a first step along this path, the government has decided to undertake a study of the sale of its interests in Government Property Services Limited(GPS) and Vehicle Testing New Zealand Limited," he added.

For GPS, the state would consider selling it by means of a float. In both these cases ministers have clearly signalled before that the government was not content with continued ownership of such businesses.
